entities.name: Query protein
observations: 318 aa protein; calculated molecular mass 37.13 kDa, theoretical pI 5.59, and predicted net charge about -13 at pH 7.
Exact sequence hash match to reviewed UniProt A4Y589, annotated as homoserine O-succinyltransferase.
Pfam HTS domain PF04204.23 spans residues 2–299.
Reference active-site annotations place the acyl-thioester intermediate at position 142 and a proton acceptor at position 235; specificity-relevant sites include positions 111 and 192.

entities.name: A4Y589
observations: Reviewed UniProt protein from Shewanella putrefaciens; exact sequence match to the query.
Annotated as homoserine O-succinyltransferase, EC 2.3.1.46, localized to the cytoplasm.
Catalyzes transfer of a succinyl group from succinyl-CoA to L-homoserine, producing O-succinyl-L-homoserine and CoA.
Participates in de novo L-methionine biosynthesis.

entities.name: RHEA:22008
observations: Reaction is assigned to homoserine O-succinyltransferase EC 2.3.1.46.

entities.name: L-methionine biosynthesis
observations: Homoserine O-succinyltransferase performs the O-succinyl-L-homoserine formation step in the de novo methionine biosynthesis pathway.
